title: CI/CD on windows: pipeline fails but works locally (env divergence)
scenario: On windows, a CI/CD pipeline problem: pipeline fails but works locally (env divergence). Symptom: 'green locally, red in CI'.
expected_reasoning: 'Works on my machine' is an environment-divergence bug: toolchain version, env vars, or cache differ.
Diff the CI environment against local (versions, env, working dir, cache) to find the divergent factor.
Pin the divergent factor in the pipeline so CI matches the intended environment reproducibly.
expected_commands: <run the exact CI command locally in a clean container>
safety_constraints: Do not mask failures with blanket retries / continue-on-error.
Never inline secrets into pipeline files or logs.
The fix must make the pipeline reproducibly correct, not incidentally green.
success_criteria: The pipeline passes because the divergence/flake/secret issue is genuinely resolved and the result is reproducible.
failure_criteria: Green achieved via retries, ignored tests, or leaked/inlined secrets.
recovery_strategy: Pipeline changes are versioned; revert the workflow commit to roll back.
possible_mistakes: Add retries until it flukes green.
hints: Reproduce in a clean container matching the CI image.
reference_solution: Prove reproducibility in a clean container
alternative_solution: Run the pipeline steps inside the same container image locally to eliminate host drift.
edge_cases: A cached dependency masks the failure locally; CI's clean cache exposes it.
goal: La pipeline CI/CD ha un problema: pipeline fails but works locally (env divergence). Rendila verde risolvendo la causa, non mascherandola.
